name: robot-markdown-companion
description: Robot Framework documentation, navigation, Test Explorer and mixed Robot/Python debugging. Experimental native backend preview.

scripts.test:all: npm run test:return-field-name-style && npm run test:run-robot && npm run test:run-environment && npm run test:html-fragment && npm run test:native-backend-layout && npm run test:native-backend && npm run test:integration && npm run test:ui && npm run test:environment-hosts && npm run test:environment-restart && npm run test:install-confirmation && npm run test:project-environment && npm run test:backend-onboarding && npm run test:trust && npm run test:multi-root && npm run test:host-disconnect

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Running tests, owned language services, owned debugging and Robot notebook/REPL sessions start configured executables and require a trusted workspace. Documentation preview, hovers, Return Explorer and folding stay available in Restricted Mode.

commands.title: Use Robot Companion as Default Folding Provider

robotCompanion.enableCodeLens.description: Show CodeLens above each [Documentation] block to open rendered preview.

robotCompanion.enableRunCodeLens.description: Show the Run Suite CodeLens on each `*** Test Cases ***` / `*** Tasks ***` header and Run Test on each test name in .robot files.

robotCompanion.robotCommand.description: Command that runs Robot Framework for Run Test / Run Suite: a plain command (`robot`), an interpreter form (`python3 -m robot`), or an absolute path, quoted if it contains spaces (`"/opt/my tools/venv/bin/robot"`). It is started without a shell. Only read in a trusted workspace.

robotCompanion.robotArguments.description: Extra Robot Framework arguments passed before Robot Companion's own `--outputdir`, `--test` and the suite file, one argument per entry (for example `["--loglevel", "DEBUG"]`). Run, Debug and the native language and discovery services share them: `--pythonpath`, `--variablefile`, `--variable`, `--extension` and `--argumentfile` also apply to navigation, diagnostics and test names, read without running any file. With the native backend, the folder's robot.toml settings (`python-path`, `variables`, `variable-files`, `extensions`, `args`) come first. Only read in a trusted workspace.

name.description: Profile name in Run Using Profile... (Debug Using Profile... shows it with " (Debug)").

include.description: Robot `--include` tag patterns, for example `smoke` or `api AND NOT slow`.

arguments.description: Further Robot arguments of this profile, one per entry, after `robotCompanion.robotArguments`.

robotCompanion.testProfiles.markdownDescription: Test Explorer run and debug profiles in owned mode. Each entry adds a Run profile with its `name`, a coverage profile `<name> (Coverage)` and, when Debug Test is available, a Debug profile `<name> (Debug)`. A profile runs only the selected tests whose tags match its `include` and `exclude` patterns (Robot's own tag pattern rules) and passes its `arguments` to Robot. Only read in a trusted workspace.

robotCompanion.continuousRunDelay.markdownDescription: Test Explorer continuous run (owned mode): milliseconds without another save of a `.robot`, `.resource` or `.py` file before the affected tests run again. Continuous run is off until you turn it on in the Testing view.

robotCompanion.enableDocumentationHoverP.description: Show rendered documentation-block preview on hover within documentation lines. Variable, enum, and return hovers remain controlled by their own settings.

robotCompanion.enableEnumValueHover.description: Show enum value hints when hovering named argument values in Robot keyword calls.

robotCompanion.enableEnumArgumentFallbac.description: Allow lower-confidence enum/type-hint fallback by argument name across keywords when no direct keyword argument mapping is found.

robotCompanion.enumCompletionDisplayMode.description: Control whether enum completions after named arguments insert enum member names, literal values, or both.

robotCompanion.logLevel.description: Controls how much Robot Companion writes to the dedicated Output channel. Use `trace` for very verbose internals such as folding diagnostics.

robotCompanion.enableVariableValueHover.description: Show variable value hover when a local Set Variable assignment is found in the same test/keyword before the cursor.

robotCompanion.enableTypedVariableComple.description: Show type-matched local return-variable suggestions in named argument value positions (for example `${order}` for `orderData=`).

robotCompanion.enableReturnMemberComplet.description: Show `${var.}` member completions for resolved return variables in named argument value positions.

robotCompanion.umlautDecoratorNames.description: Names of the Python decorator that maps ASCII argument spellings onto diacritic ones (`ue` to `ü` and so on). A keyword carrying one is indexed under its Robot-facing spelling, and lookups accept both forms. Set this if your project names that decorator differently; an empty list falls back to the default.

robotCompanion.umlautExcludeSymbols.description: Names of the module-level list holding argument keys the umlaut decorator leaves untouched. Read from whichever workspace module declares it, and accepted inside a decorator's exclude expression. Set this if your project names that list differently.

robotCompanion.camelCaseAliasBaseNames.description: Base class names that mark a Python type whose snake_case attributes are also readable in camelCase, as a generic converter base provides. Matched case-insensitively as a substring, ignoring spaces, underscores and hyphens, against every base class in the inheritance chain. The default matches any base named like `CamelCaseBase`; add your own marker class to enable `robotCompanion.returnFieldNameStyle` aliases for it, or set an empty list to disable aliasing entirely.

robotCompanion.returnFieldNameStyle.description: Controls whether return hover/explorer/member access uses camelCase aliases (`statusCode`), raw `snake_case`, or both when the resolved Python class supports CamelCase access.

robotCompanion.returnIncludeProperties.description: Include Python `@property` members in return hover/explorer/member access and technical return details when they are indexed from the resolved return type.

robotCompanion.returnMemberCompletionMax.description: Maximum member depth used by `${var.}` return-member completions in named argument values.

robotCompanion.enableReturnValueHover.description: Show structured return hints when hovering a variable assigned from a keyword call.

robotCompanion.enableReturnExplorer.description: Enable the Robot Return Explorer side view and keep it synced with the cursor.

robotCompanion.indexImportFolderPatterns.description: Workspace-relative glob roots that Robot Companion indexes (for Python, .resource, and keyword .robot scans).

robotCompanion.indexExcludeFolderPattern.description: Workspace-relative folder/glob patterns excluded from Robot Companion indexing.

robotCompanion.autoSyncSelection.description: Synchronize the side preview with the cursor position in active .robot files.

robotCompanion.enableOpenFilePrewarm.description: Prewarm runtime caches for open Robot files so side panel/hover data is available faster.

robotCompanion.prewarmMode.description: Choose whether prewarming runs for all open Robot files or only the active one.

robotCompanion.debounceMs.description: Debounce delay in milliseconds for reparsing documentation after edits.

robotCompanion.hoverLineLimit.description: Maximum number of documentation lines shown inside hover preview before truncation.

robotCompanion.enumHoverMaxEnums.description: Maximum number of matching enum types shown in enum hover.

robotCompanion.enumHoverMaxMembers.description: Maximum number of enum members shown per enum in enum hover.

robotCompanion.returnHoverMaxDepth.description: Maximum nested option depth shown in return hover (1 = top-level fields + one nested level).

robotCompanion.returnPreviewMaxDepth.description: Maximum nested option depth shown in the Robot Return Explorer side view.

robotCompanion.returnHintArgumentMaxDept.description: Maximum nested access depth shown in the 'Return Hint For Argument Value' section (hover + side panel).

robotCompanion.returnSubtypeResolutionMo.description: How generic return subtypes are resolved (for example list[T], Wrapper[T]).

robotCompanion.returnSubtypeIncludeConta.description: Container names allowed for subtype resolution in 'include' mode (case-insensitive).

robotCompanion.returnSubtypeExcludeConta.description: Container names blocked for subtype resolution in 'exclude' mode (case-insensitive).

robotCompanion.returnMaxFieldsPerType.description: Maximum number of fields shown per return object type. Set to `0` for no limit.

robotCompanion.returnTechnicalMaxDepth.description: Maximum nested depth shown in the technical (developer) section of return explorer.

robotCompanion.returnTechnicalMaxFieldsP.description: Maximum fields shown per type in the technical (developer) section.

robotCompanion.enableReturnTypeDiskCache.description: Persist worker return type cache to disk per workspace for faster startup reuse.

robotCompanion.returnTypeCacheMaxEntries.description: Maximum number of cached return type entries kept in worker memory and persisted disk cache.

robotCompanion.variableHoverLineLimit.description: Maximum number of Set Variable value lines shown inside variable hover before truncation.

robotCompanion.umlautDecoratorModuleSuff.description: Optional module path suffix preferred when several workspace modules declare `_exclude_umlaut_kwargs` defaults. Empty means no preference: the first discovered module wins.

robotCompanion.integrationMode.description: Preview default: owned mode runs the native backend from the project environment. Coexistence disables owned language, discovery and debug services.

robotCompanion.languageBackend.description: Advanced contract-v1 language descriptor override. When null, this preview uses the native language service from nativeBackendExecutable, else the folder's selected Python interpreter (Select Robot Environment), else the project .venv backend. Explicit descriptors can select robot-companion-native 0.1.0.dev1 or optional RobotCode 2.7.0. Used only in owned mode and a trusted workspace; independent of executionBackend and robotCommand.

robotCompanion.executionBackend.description: Advanced contract-v1 debug/discovery descriptor override. When null, this preview uses the native backend from nativeBackendExecutable, else the folder's selected Python interpreter (python -m robot_companion_backend), else the project .venv backend, for both services: argv ["dap"] for debug and ["discovery"] for Test Explorer. Native id robot-companion-native 0.1.0.dev1; optional RobotCode 2.7.0 remains an explicit alternative. Used only in owned mode and a trusted workspace. Independent of languageBackend; does not change robotCommand.

robotCompanion.discoveryBackend.description: Optional contract-v1 Test Explorer discovery override used when an explicit executionBackend lacks discovery, or next to the preview native default. May select native or RobotCode discovery. An explicit executionBackend.services.discovery takes precedence. With no descriptors, native discovery is the preview default. Used only in owned mode and a trusted workspace.

robotCompanion.nativeBackendExecutable.description: Preview: native backend executable. Absolute or relative to the workspace folder. Empty uses the folder's selected Python interpreter (Select Robot Environment) as python -m robot_companion_backend, or without one .venv/Scripts/robot-companion-backend.exe on Windows or .venv/bin/robot-companion-backend elsewhere. When set, it overrides the selected interpreter for language, debug and discovery unless advanced descriptors are set. Install the supplied backend wheel in that environment first.

robotCompanion.inlayHints.enabled.markdownDescription: Owned mode: show the language server's inlay hints in Robot files. Off shows none and sends no inlay hint request; Robot Companion's own hovers, Return Explorer, CodeLenses and completions are unchanged. VS Code's `editor.inlayHints.enabled` also applies.

robotCompanion.inlayHints.parameterNames.markdownDescription: Owned mode: show argument-name hints (`name=`, or `name:` for a positional-only argument) before positional keyword arguments. Requires `#robotCompanion.inlayHints.enabled#`.

robotCompanion.inlayHints.returnTypes.markdownDescription: Owned mode: show a keyword's declared return type (`: Record`) after the variable its result is assigned to. Requires `#robotCompanion.inlayHints.enabled#`.

target.description: Robot file to debug. Requires owned integration mode and robotCompanion.executionBackend.

outputLog.description: Show the test's Log messages in the Debug Console (RobotCode backend).

attachPython.description: Debug the Robot run's Python keywords in a child session (RobotCode handoff or native handoff v1).

preparedSession.description: Absolute path of the descriptor printed by `robot-companion-backend dap-prepare` (native backend only). It can be used once and expires at most 30 seconds after it is printed. Disconnect and Stop end the prepared run.
